hero.headline: Friday.
hero.description: Summon Friday, ask for help, and get back to the work in front of you. It can use files, tools, channels, schedules, and voice while keeping permissions visible.

demoSuggestions.question: Summarize my unread Slacks
demoSuggestions.answer: You have 14 unreads across 3 channels. The thread worth your attention is #launch, where Priya is blocked on the API timeout question and tagged you 11 minutes ago.

demoSuggestions.question: Draft a polite decline to Maya
demoSuggestions.answer: Hey Maya, thanks so much for the invite. I cannot make Thursday, but I would love to find another time. Want me to send a few options for next week?

demoSuggestions.question: What did I do yesterday?
demoSuggestions.answer: You spent the morning on the Friday landing page, shipped a small product update after lunch, and closed the laptop at 18:12.

landingFeatures.title: Available from the desktop
landingFeatures.description: Keep Friday close to active work with a fast prompt surface, desktop controls, and context that does not require copying everything into a browser tab.

landingFeatures.title: Remembers without hiding the record
landingFeatures.description: Local stores keep useful context such as settings, skills, channels, schedules, and session state inspectable and deletable.

landingFeatures.title: Tools with clear approval
landingFeatures.description: File edits, terminal commands, connector calls, browser actions, and publishing steps can pause for review before Friday acts.

landingFeatures.title: Your choice of model
landingFeatures.description: Route chat, voice, images, research, and realtime work through the providers you configure instead of being locked into one model.

landingFeatures.title: Reusable skills
landingFeatures.description: Package repeated work into task-specific instructions with visible tools, safety posture, metadata, and diagnostics.

landingFeatures.title: Automation you can inspect
landingFeatures.description: Scheduled prompts, heartbeat events, channel deliveries, and run state stay visible so recurring work remains accountable.

workflowSteps.title: Ask
workflowSteps.description: Start with a prompt, voice note, file, or selected workflow from the desktop app.

workflowSteps.title: Review
workflowSteps.description: Friday shows the planned work, tool requests, and permission state before sensitive actions run.

workflowSteps.title: Deliver
workflowSteps.description: Send the result back to chat, a local file, or a connected channel while keeping history available.

promptSuggestions: Inspect this folder and summarize the project
Draft a release note from recent changes
Run the test command after approval
Turn this recording into a task list
toolCategories: File reading, writing, editing, patching, copying, moving, deleting, and inspection
Workspace search across local project files
Shell command execution for tests, builds, scripts, and terminal tasks
Process inspection and stopping for commands started by Friday
Web fetching for current documentation or web data
Browser opening and managed browser control
Skill execution when a selected skill matches the task
Connector, plugin, MCP, LSP, and client-hosted tools when configured
voiceFeatures: Live dictation into chat through GPT Realtime Whisper
Audio recording from the prompt input
Audio file attachments with preview and duration display
Text-to-speech agent configuration with ElevenLabs Rachel multilingual voice
Blocked, restricted, unknown, and unsupported permission states
channelSettings: Server URL for server and workspace channels
Direct message policy: allowlist, pairing, open, or deny
Allowed sender lists for direct messages and groups
Telegram start, reconnect, and stop actions
cronDetails: Next run and last run information
Details page with id, schedule, target, delivery, timestamps, prompt, and payload
heartbeatDetails: Heartbeat runtime enable and pause control
Timing controls with 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, and disable presets
Optional active hours with start, end, and timezone
Last event status, timestamp, duration, channel, reason, and preview
System event input that can be sent immediately or queued for the next heartbeat
privacyNotes: Friday is local-first but can connect to external AI providers, channels, apps, and connectors.
API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys, and credentials are secrets and should not be logged or exposed.
Provider keys are stored locally and only used for provider calls.
Chat history, workspace paths, channel IDs, connector metadata, local files, and agent data are treated as private.
Users can inspect chat history size and clear the active conversation history.
Application data and user data folders can be opened from settings.
App settings include theme, language, translucency, menu bar visibility, keep-awake behavior, and microphone control.
Tool and connector actions that write, delete, publish, or access private data should pass permission checks.
desktopFeatures: Tray and menu bar support with show, hide, and quit
Theme modes: light, dark, and system
Translucency controls for light and dark themes
Keep computer active toggle for background work
Access to app data and user data folders
Navigation through settings sections and command/search surfaces
Error boundaries, loading states, empty states, and status notices
technicalFoundation: Electron, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn-style components
Cross-process API contracts under src/shared and src/preload
Provider adapters behind a provider abstraction
Local stores for app settings, cron schedules, skills, apps, channels, memory, and session state
Testing with Jest, Testing Library, and Playwright
